subject.title: Google Chat: replyToMode: "off" does not suppress thread replies

question: Should maintainers land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89790 as the canonical fix for Google Chat `replyToMode: "off"` threading, or switch to the broader https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/74235 path?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and an open mergeable closing PR exists, but choosing the canonical landing branch and proof stance is a human merge decision rather than a new automated issue repair.

options.title: Land the focused replacement
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89790 as the canonical thread-routing fix after live Google Chat proof or an explicit maintainer proof override.

options.title: Revive the broader source branch
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/74235 only if maintainers want the larger thread-resource preservation shape and are ready to resolve its broader merge risks.

options.title: Keep waiting for a maintainer-owned fix
options.body: Leave this issue open without new ClawSweeper repair work if neither current PR should land yet.

recommendation.title: Land the focused replacement
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89790 as the canonical thread-routing fix after live Google Chat proof or an explicit maintainer proof override.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google Chat landing/refactor history and the credited thread-reply groundwork make this the strongest routing candidate for choosing the canonical fix path.
